spanish: Y la fila la cuarta: tarsis, shóham y yashfé; rodeadas de engastes de oro en sus llenuras.

findings.issue: שֹׁהַם is a common noun (masculine singular absolute), not a proper name. shóham leaves the lemma untranslated.
יָשְׁפֵה is a common noun (masculine singular absolute), not a proper name. yashfé leaves the lemma untranslated.
«de» between the hophal participle and מִשְׁבְּצוֹת is grammatical smoothing; Hebrew juxtaposes them with no preposition.
«llenuras» denotes abstract fullness. H4396 is the concrete feminine-plural noun of settings/fillings; «en sus» already carries the preposition and the 3mp suffix.

notes: Y, la fila, la cuarta, tarsis, the single y, rodeadas (hophal feminine plural), and engastes de oro match their tokens.
